name: Heel walk & toe walk
summary: Walk a few metres on the heels with toes lifted, then back on the toes with heels lifted.
setup: Walk 5–10 m on the heels, toes pulled up, then return on the balls of the feet, heels high. Small steps, tall posture.
why: Walking toward and away from the phone changes the framing every step; the count and the foot position are not measurable. Follow the guide and log the set.
progression: Longer distance; carry a light weight.
regression: Shorter distance; hand on a wall.
contraindications: Shin or Achilles pain that builds.

faults.label: Toes or heels dropping mid-way
faults.tip: Shorten the walk before the foot drops; the position is the exercise.

faults.label: Leaning to keep balance
faults.tip: Eyes ahead, trunk upright; use small steps rather than leaning.

faults.label: Distance too short
faults.tip: The point is fatigue in the shin and calf. A few steps will not reach it.

faults.label: Bending the knees to cheat
faults.tip: Bending the knees lets the hips lift the foot instead of the shin.

guide.cannotSee: Any of it — the distance to the phone changes every step.

points.t: Toes up on the heel walk; heels high on the toe walk.
